description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00059825
Sheriff’s File # 25002025
PLAINTIFF – Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB, Not In Its Individual Capacity, But Solely As Owner Trustee for CSMC 2022-NQM5 Trust, A Delaware Statutory Trust vs:
DEFENDANTS- Yubir Rojas Gasga A/K/A Yubir Rojasgasga
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 26th day of October, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Cliffwood, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot 21 & 22 Block 161 Tax Map of Township of Aberdeen
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
126 Milton Avenue Cliffwood, NJ 07721
Dimension of Lot: 80 feet wide by 100 feet long
Nearest Cross Street: Rose Street
Estimated upset bid amount: $443,000.00 plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
Notice Through Publication.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation
to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
Water: Aberdeen Township 1 Aberdeen Township Aberdeen, NJ 07747 732-583-4200
Acct: 3584 0 01/01/2026-03/31/2026 $126.50 OPEN
Sewer: Aberdeen Township 1 Aberdeen Township Aberdeen, NJ 07747 732-583-4200
Acct: 3584 0 04/01/2026-06/30/2026 $182.00 OPEN
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $725,335.32.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: June 8, 2026
Robertson, Anschutz, Schneid, Crane & Partners, PLLC
130 Clinton Road Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
